arguments.description: 16x16 pixel-art UI status icon for the Ready (task completed successfully) state of a queue. One bold, centered check mark with clearly asymmetrical arms: a short arm rising up-left from the bottom point and a much longer arm rising up-right, like a classic tick. Chunky 2-pixel-wide strokes, filled in a cool sky blue close to #70b9ed with one lighter blue highlight tone, crisp hard pixel edges, no anti-aliased blur, no stray pixels. Must read clearly at 1x on a dark navy panel (#172336). Transparent background, no text, no circle or badge plate behind the mark, no drop shadow, single static image.
